# entity-linker

> Link mentions in text to a catalog of entities by name and alias: token-aligned longest match, case and accent insensitive, context-term disambiguation and exact character offsets Python package `trysac-entity-linker`, import name `entity_linker`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
